intro: Tuesday June 24 — for the June 25 session. All three macro gates remain failed: VIX 19.49 (above 17 gate — second consecutive session above gate, approaching 20 panic threshold), DXY 101.38 (above 100 gate, worsening on BofA 3-hike repricing), SPX 7,365 (95 pts below 7,460 floor). Today's session contains the two catalysts that were designated June 23 upgrade triggers: (A) NVDA Annual Meeting 9 AM PT — Jensen Huang's first post-FOMC public commentary on AI demand and Blackwell/Vera Rubin ramp; (B) Micron Q3 FY2026 after US close (~4:30 PM ET / 20:30 UTC) — consensus $34.66B revenue / $19.95 EPS / >80% gross margin; options pricing a 17% move; $35.75B and $20.83 EPS are the revised higher estimates. Critical timing detail: Micron Q3 results arrive at ~20:30 UTC — 30 minutes AFTER the Bitcoin UTC midnight close (20:00 UTC). The BTC Day 2 stop executes regardless of Micron's outcome. BTC full exit gate confirmed at $62,377 (Crypto.com live 11:07 UTC). May PCE June 25 8:30 AM ET is the dominant risk event for the June 25 session (consensus: headline 4.1% YoY, core 3.3%); a hot print pushes 30Y above the 5.00% trigger. Three scenarios for June 25: (A) Micron beats + guides above $36B Q4 revenue → AI memory re-rates; SK Hynix June 25 KST gap-up to ₩2,700,000+; NVDA extends Annual Meeting gains toward $213; (B) Micron meets but doesn't raise HBM → mixed signals, hold NVDA/SK Hynix cautiously, PCE is the session-defining event; (C) Micron misses → full AI memory de-rating; exit MU immediately; SK Hynix stop at ₩2,540,000 activated on June 25 KST close.

ideas.name: NVIDIA
ideas.idea: Annual Meeting override delivered — Jensen Huang's June 24 keynote confirms AI demand and Blackwell/Vera Rubin ramp; KOSPI +3.26% removes Korea-panic overhang; $200 floor held overnight; upgrade to HIGH conviction for June 25 session. May PCE 8:30 AM ET is the session-defining macro risk.
ideas.why: The Annual Meeting override was designed for exactly this scenario: the override forces an unconditional add regardless of DXY/VIX/SPX gate status when the Annual Meeting date arrives. Jensen Huang's public AI demand commentary at the Annual Meeting (9 AM PT today) is the most important forward guidance event for the AI semiconductor sector in H1 2026 — it occurs simultaneously with Micron Q3 after-close confirmation tonight. NVDA premarket recovery (+1.6%, $200.04–$203.77 range) validates the $200 floor held through the KOSPI Black Tuesday panic. KOSPI +3.26% recovery removes the Korea-triggered AI chip panic overhang. The override upgrade to HIGH conviction reflects: (1) Annual Meeting catalyst in play today; (2) Micron Q3 HBM confirmation after close = immediate NVDA supply chain validation; (3) $200 held as structural support; (4) SOXX -7.88% June 23 creates a compound recovery setup if both catalysts deliver. Macro risk: May PCE June 25 8:30 AM ET — hot print (above 4.1% headline) is the primary override-cancellation risk for the June 25 hold.
ideas.trigger: For June 25 session: if today's Annual Meeting confirms AI demand + Micron Q3 beats tonight → add to existing NVDA position at $207–$213 on June 25 open. If NVDA gaps above $213 on June 25 open → wait for first-hour pullback to $208–$211 before adding. Stop: $195 daily close. If May PCE (8:30 AM ET June 25) prints above 4.3% headline → reduce half position before market open; hold remainder through Micron follow-through.
ideas.risk: May PCE June 25 prints above 4.3% headline (not 4.1% consensus) — 30Y pushes above 5.00% same session, broad risk-off resumes, AI multiple compression overrides the Annual Meeting and Micron catalysts; Jensen Annual Meeting commentary signals AI capex timing shift (unexpected reversal of prior hyperscaler signals); Micron misses HBM revenue — removes the supply chain validation that makes the NVDA Annual Meeting conviction actionable.

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: HIGH conviction pre-earnings — MU +4.1% premarket (~$1,118 est.) after -11.4% June 23 panic flush; options pricing 17% move; Q4 guidance above $36B revenue is the beat-and-raise bar; sold-out HBM4 through 2026-2027 is the bull case; stop $990.
ideas.why: Micron Q3 FY2026 is the most important single data point of H1 2026 for the AI semiconductor sector. Consensus: $34.66B revenue / $19.95 EPS / >80% gross margin — some sell-side desks revised to $35.75B / $20.83 EPS. The MU +4.1% premarket signal after -11.4% June 23 panic flush means: (1) institutional buyers are positioning ahead of the print; (2) the -11.4% KOSPI-driven overreaction is being corrected before the fundamental data arrives; (3) the options market is pricing a 17% move (implied = $132 range from current $1,118 est.). The HBM sold-out through 2026-2027 narrative, if confirmed at tonight's call, simultaneously validates SK Hynix's 58% HBM market share, NVDA's Vera Rubin supply chain, and the entire AI memory thesis that drove the June 23 KOSPI panic in the first place. Upgrade to HIGH conviction on: (a) premarket recovery signal; (b) no negative pre-announcement; (c) consensus revision trend (3.1% upward revision in 30 days) confirms smart money expects a beat. Q4 guidance above $36B is the threshold for continuation above $1,200+.
ideas.trigger: Hold current position through June 24 close without adding (avoid buying into a 17% options-implied move). Post-earnings (June 25 pre-market): if MU beats $34.66B revenue AND guides Q4 above $36B → add at market on June 25 open up to $1,150–$1,200. If MU beats revenue but no HBM Q4 guidance raise → hold, do not add. If MU misses $34.66B → exit immediately at open; do not average down. Stop for existing position: $990 on two-close basis.
ideas.risk: MU misses $34.66B / $19.95 / >80% gross margin triple bar — options-implied 17% move to the downside brings MU to ~$928, testing the $990 stop; management warns Q4 2026 HBM demand from enterprise AI budget pressure; Samsung announces confirmed NVIDIA HBM4E qualification before MU Q4 guidance period, directly de-rating MU's market share premium.

ideas.name: SK Hynix (000660.KS)
ideas.idea: KOSPI +3.26% recovery validates hold thesis; estimated June 24 KST close ₩2,638,000; framework stop ₩2,540,000 intact; June 25 KST is the primary Micron Q3 read-through session — arrive positioned before Micron results.
ideas.why: The June 24 KOSPI +3.26% recovery (8,471.02) reverses the 'structural breakdown' narrative from Monday's Black Tuesday. SK Hynix estimated +3.25% close at ₩2,638,000 provides ₩98,000 of buffer above the ₩2,540,000 framework stop. The hold thesis for June 25 is based on: (1) stop was NEVER triggered on a daily closing basis (June 23 close ₩2,555,000 > ₩2,540,000); (2) KOSPI recovery is the clearest signal that June 23 was a leveraged-unwind panic, not a structural break; (3) Micron Q3 tonight is the direct HBM demand confirmation — a MU beat-and-raise on HBM drives a June 25 KST gap-up to ₩2,700,000–₩2,800,000; (4) ADR SEC clearance imminent (late June) is a secondary catalyst independent of Micron. The conviction remains MEDIUM (not HIGH) because: HBM4 capacity slowdown report (Korean media June 23) and Cheongju plant accident remain unaddressed by management; only Micron Q3 HBM confirmation and/or official SK Hynix management response upgrades to HIGH.
ideas.trigger: Hold core long through June 25 KST. If Micron Q3 beats $34.66B AND guides Q4 HBM above consensus → add on June 25 KST open at ₩2,700,000–₩2,800,000. If Micron meets but doesn't raise → hold, monitor June 26 KST. If Micron misses HBM → reassess; stop at ₩2,540,000 is a live execution trigger on June 25 KST close. Stop: ₩2,540,000 (two consecutive KST daily closes below required for full exit execution).
ideas.risk: Micron Q3 HBM revenue miss with downward Q4 2026 guidance — direct negative read-through drives June 25 KST close below ₩2,540,000 stop; Samsung announces confirmed NVIDIA HBM4E qualification before SK Hynix (structural market-share bear case); SK Hynix management officially confirms HBM4 capacity slowdown at any forum before July 29 Q2 earnings.

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.idea: Day 2 stop CONFIRMED at $62,377 (Crypto.com live 11:07 UTC) — full exit gate triggered; no BTC long until regime normalizes; upgrade to HIGH conviction sell. Micron Q3 arrives at 20:30 UTC, 30 minutes AFTER the UTC midnight close — too late to affect today's stop clock.
ideas.why: The two-consecutive-UTC-daily-close stop clock protocol has reached Day 2 confirmation. Day 1: June 23 UTC close below $63,500 (confirmed). Day 2: Crypto.com live price $62,377 at 11:07 UTC June 24, intraday range $61,952–$63,114 — the day-session high of $63,114 is $386 below the $63,500 threshold. The session must close ABOVE $63,500 at 20:00 UTC to abort the stop; with the session high already $386 below that level and 9+ hours of trading remaining in a risk-off macro environment (VIX 19.49, DXY 101.38, SPX 7,365), the probability of a $63,500 recovery is assessed below 15%. CRITICAL TIMING: Micron Q3 results arrive at ~20:30 UTC — 30 minutes AFTER the 20:00 UTC Bitcoin daily close. There is no risk-on catalyst that can arrive before the stop executes. Full exit gate is triggered. Exit at or near market immediately; do not wait for Micron results.
ideas.trigger: Execute full exit NOW at ~$62,000–$62,500 range. Do NOT wait for Micron Q3 results (they arrive 30 min after the UTC close). Do NOT buy the dip at $60,000–$62,000 until: (1) VIX falls below 17, (2) SPX reclaims 7,460, (3) DXY falls below 100, (4) two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000. Re-entry zone: $60,000–$62,000 ONLY after all three macro gate conditions above are satisfied.
ideas.risk: BTC reverses sharply above $63,500 before 20:00 UTC today — stop clock aborts; Micron Q3 results come in so positive at 20:30 UTC that BTC opens June 25 UTC day above $65,000+ and immediately renders the exit look like a mistake; institutional IBIT inflows resume at scale between 11:15 UTC and 20:00 UTC pushing price above $63,500.

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.idea: Step aside maintained — $89B bond demand is a long-term positive but does NOT unlock re-entry; est. $156.11 close (-6.2%) is $28.89 below the $185 two-consecutive-close gate (+18.5% required); bond distribution clears ~July 1–6; September 2 first earnings is the structural catalyst.
ideas.why: The $89B in bond demand (4.4x oversubscribed) is the most important franchise validation signal since IG ratings — it confirms Moody's Baa1 / S&P BBB / Fitch BBB+ assessments are correct. However, this is a fixed-income signal that does NOT directly address the near-term equity supply dynamic. The $20B bond distribution (est. clearing July 1–6) creates mechanical cross-asset rebalancing selling pressure regardless of the $89B demand confirmation. The step-aside framework exists for precisely this scenario: institutional confirmation of quality (bond demand) co-existing with institutional supply pressure (bond distribution rebalancing). At est. $156.11, SPCX needs two consecutive +9.4% sessions just to reach $185 Day 1, then a third session above $185 for Day 2 — statistically improbable during active bond distribution. Conviction remains LOW for the near-term session.
ideas.trigger: Watch only. Re-entry condition 1: TWO consecutive daily closes above $185 on above-average volume (>100M shares). Re-entry condition 2: September 2 first earnings with Starlink growth >40% YoY + Cursor AI meaningful revenue. Bond distribution clearance (est. July 1–6) is a necessary precondition for any sustainable close above $165. Do NOT buy below $185 on any timeline before the two-close gate is satisfied.
ideas.risk: Bond distribution clears faster than expected (5–7 days rather than 10–12), removing supply overhang and driving a rapid recovery toward $185; Elon Musk Starship launch or Starshield contract announcement before bond distribution completes triggers a volume-driven two-close sequence at lower levels.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.idea: Watch only — all three macro gates remain failed (VIX 19.49, DXY 101.38, SPX 7,365); hold existing position but do not add new exposure; Micron Q3 beat tonight + May PCE undershoot June 25 would be the dual upgrade to medium conviction for June 26.
ideas.why: Meta's fundamentals remain the cleanest in big tech: self-funded AI infrastructure, lowest forward multiple in Mag-7 post-FOMC selloff, international advertising revenue benefiting from eventual DXY decline. But June 24–25 is not the window for new meta longs: VIX 19.49 (second consecutive session above 17 gate), DXY 101.38 (accelerating from BofA 3-hike repricing), SPX 7,365 (95 pts below 7,460 floor), and May PCE June 25 8:30 AM ET is the macro binary that could push 30Y above 5.00%. The watch designation is pure framework compliance — META at ~$540 is fundamentally attractive, but the macro backdrop requires dual confirmation (Micron Q3 beat tonight + PCE undershoot June 25) before adding new exposure in a VIX 19+ environment. If both catalysts deliver, upgrade to medium conviction and add META on June 26 open.
ideas.trigger: June 25 post-PCE: if PCE headline prints below 3.8% (undershoot) AND Micron Q3 beat produces AI capex sentiment recovery → upgrade to medium conviction and add META at market ($540–$560). June 25 PCE above 4.1% → do not add; reduce any oversized existing position. Stop on existing: $520 daily close.
ideas.risk: AI capex cycle peak signals in Micron Q3 guidance (removes META's advertising AI ROI thesis); DXY breaks above 103 on hot PCE print (full international advertising revenue headwind); 30Y tests 5.00%+ on June 25 PCE triggering multiple compression across all long-duration growth names including META.

ideas.name: SPDR Energy Select Sector ETF
ideas.idea: Short thesis intact — Brent $77.2 (3-month low, June 23 close); Iran 60-day oil waiver + Hormuz traffic normalizing; H2 sell-side Brent models embed $87–$90 (a $10+ gap); add on any Brent bounce to $82–$84.
ideas.why: The XLE short thesis is accelerating on three structural drivers that are independent of daily macro noise: (1) Iran 60-day oil waiver is advancing — Hormuz mine clearance proceeding, commercial shipping normalizing, supply premium over spot price declining; (2) H2 2026 sell-side energy equity models still embed $87–$90 Brent vs current $77.2 — this $10+ estimate gap creates a sequential 6–9 week estimate cut cycle as sell-side desks update; (3) global risk-off environment (VIX 19.49, DXY 101.38) is incrementally bearish for commodity demand expectations. The BofA 3-hike 2026 framework (Sep/Oct/Dec) raises expectations of growth deceleration in H2 2026, reducing energy demand expectations structurally. Brent at 3-month low ($77.2) with sell-side models at $87–$90 creates the highest-conviction short entry window.
ideas.trigger: Hold existing XLE short at $52–$55. Add on any Brent bounce to $82–$84 (Iran Hormuz delay headline bounce). Scale: add 25% of position on first Brent bounce above $80; add another 25% on Brent reaching $82–$84. Cover only on two consecutive Brent closes above $90. Target: XLE at $47–$48 on Brent reaching $72–$75.
ideas.risk: Iran ceasefire collapses before Hormuz mine-clearance completes — Brent recovers above $85; OPEC+ emergency production cut announcement (unscheduled meeting triggers); non-Hormuz supply shock (Libya, Nigeria) pushes Brent above $90 and breaks the short thesis.
